title: The Old Boat
offer: This old boat was mine when I was young. Row it to Kråkhamn, the market village, and greet Ulf the warden. And bring me a crate of salt on the way back!

steps.say: So you are Åsa's girls! Welcome to Kråkhamn. Here you can buy and sell everything. Salt is cheap here: it comes from far away by ship.
Salt! Now I can keep the butter and the fish. You rowed well. The boat is yours now.

fact: Vikings kept food with salt, smoke and drying: there was no ice in summer.
